title: The sunny stop
objective: Introduce Charme Envoûtant in a warm street-style pause using clothing, hand movement and the red scooter as texture.
casting: One adult Filipino man. Black label men's bottle. Hands, arms and torso only; no heads, faces, partial faces, reflected faces or background people.
description: Rich, spiced sweetness that feels deep and indulgent.
scene: Close waist-and-hand crop of an adult Filipino man beside a parked cherry-red scooter. He wears a burnt-orange overshirt over a cream tee and light trousers. A burgundy strap and small chrome rail provide shape; a red wall fills the background.
styling: Burnt-orange cotton, cream tee and trousers, natural short nails. Crop below collarbones, never include a chin or mouth.
props: Correct capped Charme bottle; parked scooter side panel; burgundy bag strap. Keep the scooter unbranded, still and switched off.

camera: Waist-height close-up at a slight downward angle; move only sideways for a short reveal. Avoid tilting up or using a wide mirror-heavy angle.
performance: Adjust the strap, pick up the bottle by the glass body, then settle beside the scooter. Hands should look relaxed rather than posed for power or status.
sound: Licensed warm rhythmic track, cotton movement and a small strap-buckle sound. No engine start is needed for this stationary scene.
